The PoV is the single @import file.)

category5.design: The injected code drops `if (fd == nullptr) return nullptr;` after fopen(), so when stat() succeeds but fopen() fails the vulnerable build calls fread()/fclose() on a NULL FILE* and crashes. The PoV imports an absolute path the judge stages as a root-owned mode-0000 file; the PoC runs as an unprivileged user, so stat() succeeds and fopen() fails deterministically (no race). The secure build returns cleanly.
